text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Energy refurbishment costs a lot of money, takes a long time, and the complicated services technology confuses building owners.", "gist": "Energy refurbishment is expensive, time-consuming, and confusing for building owners."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "In St. Gallen there is a newly refurbished office building from the sixties which dispels such thoughts completely.", "gist": "A newly refurbished 1960s office building in St. Gallen disproves the negative perceptions of energy refurbishment."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "St. Gallen property company Mettiss AG", "gist": "Mettiss AG, a property company in St. Gallen"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Kegel’s Rule", "gist": "Beat Kegel’s energy concept named Kegel’s Rule"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "This is due to a cost-effective low-technology heating and ventilation system incorporated in prefabricated parapet elements and connector fans in the doors.", "gist": "The successful refurbishment used a cost-effective low-tech heating and ventilation system in prefabricated elements and door fans."}]}
